resumeText:
DANIEL PIERCE
Perth, WA | 0400 123 456 | daniel.pierce@example.com
Australian Citizen - full working rights

SUMMARY
Passionate and hard-working individual with a strong desire to learn and grow, looking to bring energy and dedication to a new team.

SKILLS
HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Git, Responsive Design, REST APIs

EXPERIENCE

Freelance Web Developer, Self-employed, Perth WA
09/2023 - Present
- Responsible for building small business websites using React and JavaScript.
- Responsible for writing REST APIs for client contact forms and booking widgets.
- Attending client meetings to gather requirements and provide updates.
- Responsible for maintaining Git repositories for each client project.

Front of House Supervisor, The Merchant Kitchen, Perth WA
02/2019 - 06/2022
Worked front-of-house in a busy CBD restaurant while studying web development in the evenings; the role built the client communication and calm-under-pressure skills I now bring to freelance and team-based development work.
- Responsible for rostering staff and coordinating floor service during peak periods.
- Trained new starters on POS systems and service standards.
- Handled customer feedback and resolved complaints on the floor.

PROJECTS

Local Cafe Finder
- Built a React application that lets users search and filter Perth cafes by suburb and opening hours.
- Used the Fetch API to pull data from a mock REST endpoint and render results with responsive CSS layout.

Recipe Organiser
- A JavaScript and HTML/CSS app for saving and tagging recipes, using localStorage for persistence.
- Implemented a responsive grid layout that adapts from mobile to desktop.

Personal Portfolio Site
- Designed and built a personal portfolio using HTML, CSS and JavaScript to showcase the above projects.
- Included a responsive navigation menu and contact form wired to a REST API endpoint.

EDUCATION
Self-Taught Developer, Online Courses (freeCodeCamp, The Odin Project) - Completed 08/2023
Covered HTML, CSS, JavaScript fundamentals, React, Git and REST API integration through project-based coursework.

Certificate III in Hospitality, Central TAFE, Perth WA - Completed 12/2018
